name: Ligus 0.5.0
notes: Ligus (short for ligustica) 0.5.0 makes you one person on all your devices: link a new device with a short code, and one link brings all your workspaces. Adding an agent is one step, with its model and where it runs. A turn that can't run says so instead of quietly falling back, and a Set up Ligus checklist shows what's left. Update the box and every device first. See https://docs.langstroth.ai/ligus/reference/whats-new/.
